summary: A WHERE clause whose own parenthesis level mixes AND and OR fails the build; docstrings, comments and $$ bodies are skipped; suppress with a reasoned # sql-precedence-ok marker.
changelog: - New gate `sql_where_mixed_and_or` (hard, no advisory mode): a SQL string whose WHERE level holds both AND and OR (without brackets) fails. Depth-aware; BETWEEN and CASE are handled; docstrings, comments and plpgsql $$ bodies are skipped. Suppress with `# sql-precedence-ok: <reason>`.
owner_actions: Add a [[gate]] entry for sql_where_mixed_and_or to src/py_ci_shared/registry.toml and a README catalogue row (owner-owned files; not edited here).
glossum scripts (not measured here) hold one plpgsql script that the $$ rule skips by design; the measured pyutilz/src and mlframe/src corpora are clean.
